review_text: After a college friend recommended Grapple, I decided to check it out. As someone with four years of BJJ experience, I believe cross-training is key to improving your skills. Having trained at six different gyms across Mississippi, I can confidently say Grapple stands out as one of my favorite places to roll. Though it's not my home gym, Grapple feels like a second home. The members are welcoming, genuine, and stay connected with me regularly. I've built strong relationships with the owner and many teammates, who care not only about sharpening my BJJ skills but also about me as a person. Their support extends beyond the mats, making every visit meaningful. Training at Grapple has boosted my confidence in multiple areas of my BJJ game. If you're in the Rankin area looking to compete or simply want a great workout, Grapple is an excellent choice for learning and growing in a supportive environment.
